title: Car Insurance
intro: Car insurance pays for damage to your own car and is legally required to cover harm you cause to others; what matters most is how reliably the insurer pays own-damage claims, how many garages offer cashless repair, and add-ons like zero depreciation.
sources: Insurer public disclosures NL-37 (claims data), FY2024-25
IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25 (Statement 12, solvency ratios as at 31 Mar 2025)

params.label: Own-damage claim settlement
params.tip: Motor own-damage claims settled by count, FY2024-25: settled / (settled + repudiated + closed without payment). Insurer public disclosures NL-37.

params.label: Third-party claim settlement
params.tip: Motor third-party claims settled by count, FY2024-25 (insurer public disclosures NL-37). Third-party claims go through courts and tribunals, so ratios are lower and slower for most insurers.

params.label: Cashless garages
params.tip: Cashless network garages as stated on the insurer's car insurance page (Oct 2026). Figures are 'X+'.

params.label: Zero depreciation add-on
params.tip: Offers a zero (nil) depreciation add-on for private cars, per insurer page (Oct 2026).

params.label: Solvency ratio
params.tip: As at 31 Mar 2025, IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25. Regulatory minimum is 1.5x.

params.label: Key add-ons
params.tip: Main add-ons listed on the insurer's car insurance page (Oct 2026).

params.label: Claim process
params.tip: How claims are filed and inspected, per insurer page (Oct 2026).

items.name: ICICI Lombard Car Insurance

v.addOns: Zero depreciation, engine protect, roadside assistance, consumables, key protect, return to invoice
v.claimProcess: App-based claims with InstaSpect video self-inspection

pros: Full add-on set including zero depreciation and engine protect
cons: Claim settlement and garage figures not available here
Website did not show a garage count when checked
items.best: Buyers who want a large private insurer with app-based claims

items.name: Bajaj General Car Insurance

v.addOns: Zero depreciation, engine protector, 24x7 roadside assistance, consumables, NCB protector, tyre safeguard, return to invoice
v.claimProcess: Register and settle from the accident spot in the Bajaj General app with photo upload

cons: Third-party settlement (73.7%) below many peers
Zero depreciation and engine cover cost extra as add-ons
items.best: Owners who want a high own-damage settlement record and a financially strong insurer

items.name: HDFC ERGO Car Insurance

v.addOns: Zero depreciation, engine protection, roadside assistance, consumables, NCB protection, tyre secure, return to invoice, EMI protector, pay-as-you-drive
v.claimProcess: Raise and track claims online; overnight repairs for minor damage

cons: Own-damage settlement below Bajaj, Acko and Go Digit
Claims page does not mention video inspection
items.best: Buyers who want a large garage network and many add-on choices

items.name: Tata AIG Car Insurance

v.addOns: Depreciation reimbursement, engine secure, tyre secure, roadside assistance, NCB protection, consumables, return to invoice, key replacement
v.claimProcess: Register via app, website, WhatsApp or phone; video inspection instead of surveyor visit

pros: Video inspection and WhatsApp claim registration
cons: Lowest own-damage (87.9%) and third-party (68.5%) settlement among insurers with data here
Solvency (1.81x) on the lower side
items.best: Buyers who value digital claim channels like WhatsApp and video inspection

items.name: Digit Car Insurance

v.addOns: Zero depreciation, engine and gearbox protection, return to invoice, pay-as-you-drive, breakdown assistance, tyre protect, consumables, EV shield
v.claimProcess: File in the Digit app with smartphone self-inspection photos and live tracking

pros: Third-party settlement of 98.1%, among the highest here
cons: Own-damage settlement (94.5%) below Bajaj and Acko
Fewer physical branches than older insurers
items.best: Buyers who want a fully digital policy and claims experience

items.name: Acko Car Insurance

v.addOns: Zero depreciation, engine protection, roadside assistance, NCB protection, consumables, return to invoice, key replacement
v.claimProcess: Register in the Acko app or website with document upload; instant settlement for some minor claims

cons: Smaller cashless network (4,000+)
Few physical branches if you prefer in-person help
items.best: Buyers comfortable with an online-only insurer who want strong own-damage settlement

items.name: New India Private Car Package Policy

v.addOns: Optional covers listed on policy page; details vary by office
v.claimProcess: Online claim intimation, then surveyor inspection; cashless at listed garages

pros: Highest own-damage (99.1%) and third-party (99.5%) settlement here
cons: Its NL-37 has no 'closed without payment' row, so its ratio is not fully comparable
Garage count and add-on details not stated clearly online
items.best: Buyers who prefer a government-owned insurer with a long claims record

items.name: IndusInd General Car Insurance

v.addOns: Nil depreciation, engine protection, 24/7 roadside assistance, return to invoice, tyre protection, key replacement, consumables, EV add-ons
v.claimProcess: App claims with video claim and self-inspection; surveyor within 24 hours

pros: Video claims and self-inspection in app
cons: Own-damage (90.5%) and third-party (73.1%) settlement below most peers
Solvency ratio not available here
items.best: Buyers who want a large garage network and video claims

items.name: SBI General Car Insurance

v.addOns: Depreciation reimbursement, engine guard, consumables, roadside assistance, NCB protection (13+ add-ons)
v.claimProcess: Phone or email intimation; inspection within 24 hours on working days

cons: Claims page does not mention app or video inspection
Own-damage settlement below Bajaj, Acko and Go Digit
items.best: SBI customers and buyers who want a bank-backed insurer

items.name: IFFCO Tokio Car Insurance

v.addOns: Zero depreciation, engine and gearbox protection, roadside assistance, consumables, key replacement, tyre replacement
v.claimProcess: Intimate by toll-free number or website, upload photos and documents

pros: Standard add-on set including zero depreciation
cons: Claim settlement and solvency figures not available here
Claims page does not mention app or video inspection
items.best: Buyers who want a mid-size private insurer with a wide garage network

items.name: Chola MS Car Insurance

v.addOns: Zero depreciation, hydrostatic (engine) cover, consumables, key replacement, personal belongings, roadside assistance
v.claimProcess: Call motor claims line; live video streaming inspection instead of physical survey

cons: Claim settlement and solvency figures not available here
Claims start with a phone call rather than an app
items.best: Buyers who want the widest cashless garage choice

items.name: Zuno Car Insurance

v.addOns: Depreciation protection, engine protection, NCB protection, fuel guard, roadside assistance (10 add-ons)
v.claimProcess: Toll-free intimation; settlement within 7 working days of documents

pros: Unusual add-ons like fuel guard for blended-fuel damage
Zero depreciation and engine protection available
cons: Smallest stated garage network here (3,300+)
Claim settlement and solvency figures not available here
items.best: Low-mileage, digital-first buyers who want niche add-ons

items.name: Zurich Kotak Car Insurance

v.addOns: Zero depreciation, engine protect, roadside assistance, consumables, tyre protect, clutch protect, return to invoice, personal belongings
v.claimProcess: Call 1800-2120; inspection within 24 hours; settlement within 7 days of documents

cons: Claim settlement and solvency figures not available here
No app or video inspection mentioned on claims page
items.best: Kotak customers wanting a mainstream comprehensive policy

items.name: Generali Central Car Insurance

v.addOns: Zero depreciation, engine protector, return to invoice, NCB protection, tyre damage, key loss, personal belongings, inconvenience allowance
v.claimProcess: Online or toll-free intimation, surveyor inspection; GCI Xpress for faster repairs

cons: Claim settlement and solvency figures not available here
Claims page does not mention app or video inspection
items.best: Buyers wanting an inconvenience allowance while the car is in the garage
